description.content: State of the nearest ancestor tab (returned by useParentTabState).
The user cannot close the tab (because of its disableClose flag or the Workspace's disabled prop).
The user cannot drag the tab (because of its disableDrag flag or the Workspace's disabled prop).
The tab is selected within its tabset.
This is true even if the tabset is covered by another, maximized tabset.
The tab is selected, and its tabset is neither collapsed nor covered by another, maximized tabset.

While a separator is being dragged, this reflects how the tab's tabset is shown (e.g. collapsed as soon as it reaches its collapsed size), which the model only reflects once the drag ends; it also reflects tabsets that are collapsed to fit (see TabsetNode.collapsible).
This value does not account for the Workspace itself being hidden.
Id of the tabset that currently contains the tab.
